segments:
Pray like this: Our Father who art in heaven! Hallowed be thy Name,
thy kingdom come,
Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven; Give us our daily bread today, and forgive us our trespasses,
as we also forgive those who trespass against us, and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil.
